items.title: Percy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: the whole concept of the Modern Jazz Quartet including four people in Brook Brother’s suits

ctx.x: Which was different from the way you played under Milt Jackson with kind of a freer blowing…

It was not freer flowing. It was just, in the fashion of a rhythm section and soloists, which was the concept that John wanted to get away from, because he didn’t want to present this music in nightclubs. This is a master plan of John Lewis, the whole thing, the whole concept of the Modern Jazz Quartet including four people in Brook Brother’s suits, on concert stage tuxedos. This was to elevate the presentation of the music not only visually, but the sound, to get out of those Birdland’s and wherever, those…
